description: WP-C7 Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) SWEEPING ADVANCE (Shield-Captain on Dawneagle Jetbike, once per battle) at the end of the Fight phase. Fixture cus11e_c7_fight (P1 Custodes' Fight phase). Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; the Orks (P2) have 0 CP; the Boyz engaged with Trajann are removed and Gretchin D is reduced to one model (so the fight ends after one combat). The start-of-phase window is declined by a real click; after the pile-ins a real click selects the Shield-Captain to fight and it destroys the last Gretchin. P1 ends the Fight phase through the real panel; the SweepingAdvanceDialog offers a normal move (the unit was eligible to fight and is now unengaged); a real drag moves it 3" and a real click on Confirm Move finishes it: the once-per-battle ledger is marked.

steps.script:
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
for m in GameState.state.units["U_BOYZ_B"].models:
	m["alive"] = false
	m["current_wounds"] = 0
var gd = GameState.state.units["U_GRETCHIN_D"].models
for i in range(gd.size()):
	if i != 2:
		gd[i]["alive"] = false
		gd[i]["current_wounds"] = 0
return true
